user.title: Add a CamAlert receiver
user.description: IP address of the Enigma2 receiver with the CamAlert plugin. Port, HTTPS and token as set in CamAlert on the receiver.

data.verify_ssl: Check certificate (off for CamAlert's own certificate)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the receiver. Is it on, is CamAlert installed and is the port correct?
error.forbidden: The receiver refused the request: check the token, or 'Allowed callers' in CamAlert.

show.name: Show camera
show.description: Shows a camera on the TV of one or more receivers.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Name of the camera (as in go2rtc), e.g. front_door. Empty = default camera of the receiver.

seconds.name: Duration
seconds.description: How long the camera stays on screen. Empty = setting of the receiver.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: normal: follows the receiver's rules (active hours, not while recording). high: always (doorbell). alarm: always, and may wake the receiver.

mosaic.name: Show mosaic
mosaic.description: Shows several cameras at once (photo mosaic).

cameras.name: Cameras
cameras.description: Up to 9 cameras. Empty = mosaic setting of the receiver.

seconds.name: Duration
seconds.description: How long the camera stays on screen. Empty = setting of the receiver.

hide.name: Hide camera
hide.description: Closes the camera and returns to TV.
